project_type: Node.js 20 + TypeScript (strict) backend service with a no-bundler vanilla HTML/JS/CSS dashboard served by Express; real-time via ws WebSocket; PM2 programmatic API integration.
language: TypeScript 5 (strict), compiled with tsc to dist/; dashboard is plain ES-module JavaScript (no build step).
build_system: npm (npm 10.8.2) + tsc. tsconfig: strict, target ES2022, module/moduleResolution NodeNext, outDir dist, rootDir src, esModuleInterop, skipLibCheck, types:[node]. module NodeNext means relative imports in src must use explicit .js extensions in the emitted module graph; author imports accordingly (TS NodeNext requires .js suffixes on relative imports). Dev runner is tsx (watch).
test_framework: Node built-in node:test + node:assert, run through tsx (no heavy test dependency, per NFR3/design Testability). Test files are src/**/*.test.ts. API/WS integration tests use Node's own http + ws clients against the real app with a fake Pm2Client (no supertest).
build_command: npm run build  (= tsc). Zero errors required under strict mode. npm run typecheck (= tsc --noEmit) for a type-only check.
verification_instructions: Per feature: run that feature's own verification commands. Cross-cutting acceptance (design + requirements AC1-AC7): (1) npm install succeeds; (2) npm run build => zero tsc strict errors; (3) npm test passes; (4) boot-without-PM2: with no pm2 daemon running, build then `node dist/index.js` with a minimal apikey-mode .env, confirm the process stays up, `curl localhost:$PORT/` returns dashboard HTML, `curl localhost:$PORT/api/system/health` returns JSON with pm2Connected:false, and it logs a reconnect warning without crashing; stop the process afterward.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. dist/ is build output (gitignored). logs/ is created lazily at runtime only when ERROR_LOG_APPEND=true (gitignored). node_modules gitignored.
environment_constraints: Node 20.19.2, npm 10.8.2 available. PM2 is NOT installed/running in this environment and MUST NOT be started — the app must degrade gracefully when the daemon is unreachable (this is an explicit acceptance test). MS Teams delivery uses the Node 20 global fetch (no HTTP-client dependency). SMTP/Teams real delivery is not exercised in CI; payload builders are pure and unit-tested, the single network line is left for manual POST /api/alerts/test.
contribution_requirements: From requirements.md NFR4/AC20-AC22: secrets read only from env; .gitignore must cover node_modules/, dist/, .env, logs/ (the repo's existing .gitignore has node_modules/, dist/, *.log but NOT .env or logs/ — add both explicit lines). Never commit .env/node_modules/dist. No git commit unless everything builds and boots; stage specific files only, never `git add .`. Pin all dependency versions exactly (no ^/~). Validate all API inputs with zod. Sanitize script-path and process-name inputs against injection.
key_patterns: Central in-memory state hub (MonitorState) owns the canonical snapshot; no module calls another module's internals directly — they communicate through the hub plus a typed MonitorEvents EventEmitter (events: state:update, process:transition, pm2:connected, pm2:disconnected, metrics:tick (ProcessSnapshot[]), error:captured, log:line, alert). Pm2Client is the ONLY module that imports the pm2 package and it owns the single metrics setInterval poll loop that emits metrics:tick. MetricsStore.getSeries is reached ONLY via MonitorState.getMetrics (hub boundary). Single length-guarded safeEqual (sha256->32-byte digests->timingSafeEqual, never throws) is the ONLY credential comparison, reused by both REST auth and WS upgrade. Alert dispatch uses Promise.allSettled so one channel failure never blocks the other. zod discriminatedUnion('type',...) for alert-rule conditions; type AlertRule = z.infer<typeof alertRuleSchema>. Logger has a redaction set (API_KEY, BASIC_PASS, SMTP_PASS, TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL) and a redactUrl helper (token=... -> token=***). Read design.md 'Round-3 resolutions' section — MEDIUM-1 (Pm2Client owns metrics:tick loop), MEDIUM-2 (ErrorTracker rings sized to max rule window), MEDIUM-3 (restart overlimit drives errored ONLY, not the restart counter) are binding.
relevant_files: .agents/tasks/design.md (SOURCE OF TRUTH — full architecture, data model, REST/WS surface, error-handling table, Round-3 resolutions)
.agents/tasks/plan.md (fallback ordered plan — same work, item by item)
directory_structure: Target layout from design 'On-disk project layout': root package.json/tsconfig.json/ecosystem.config.js/.env.example/.gitignore/README.md; config/alert-rules.example.json; public/ (index.html, css/styles.css, js/{app,api,ws}.js, js/views/{overview,detail,logs}.js); src/ with index.ts, config/{env,alertRules}.ts, core/{logger,events,types,state}.ts, pm2/{client,mapper}.ts, errors/{tracker,signature}.ts, metrics/store.ts, alerts/{engine,cooldown,digest}.ts + alerts/channels/{types,teams,email}.ts, api/{server,auth,validate,schemas}.ts + api/routes/{processes,logs,errors,alerts,system}.ts, ws/hub.ts. Tests live beside sources as *.test.ts; shared test fakes under src/testutil/.
